description: This file defines API endpoints related to user authentication and profile management, utilizing FastAPI. It includes login, current user retrieval, profile update, and token refresh functionalities, interfacing with a database repository and utilizing utility functions for user data handling.

methods.name: login_user(login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying email and password, returning a mock token and user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile(request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the current user profile based on trusted user data.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile with provided data.

methods.name: refresh_access_token(request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)
methods.description: Refreshes the user's access token, returning a mock token.

ctags.name: get_current_user_profile
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_current_user_profile(request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None):$/

ctags.signature: (login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)

ctags.name: refresh_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^async def refresh_access_token(request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None):$/
